description: Defines the StatusTracker class for managing camera component states and synchronization in Android's camera service.

classes.name: StatusTracker
classes.description: Manages idle and active states of camera components, synchronizing status updates and notifying parent device.

methods.name: addComponent
methods.description: Adds a new component to track, returning a unique ID.

methods.name: markComponentIdle
methods.description: Marks a component as idle, optionally waiting on a fence.

methods.name: dumpActiveComponents
methods.description: Outputs current active components for debugging.
